name: Signature Talent (Combat)
body:
You really focus on some of your talents.

Prerequisite(s): Vigilante level 2nd.

Benefit(s): Select one vigilante talent, even if you don’t currently possess it. You reduce any level requirement to select it and vigilante talents which require it as a prerequisite by 2. You can also select 1 of the following benefits:

If the vigilante talent has a limited number of uses per day, you gain 1 additional use of it per day.
If the vigilante talent allows a saving throw, increase the DC by +1.
If the vigilante talent requires an attack roll or grants you a feat, you gain a +1 on attack rolls with that talent or when using that feat with an attack roll.
If the vigilante talent would provide a benefit at a higher level, you treat your vigilante talent as 2 levels higher for the purposes of its effects.

Special: You can select this feat multiple times, either selecting a different vigilante talent or gaining two more benefits from this feat for a vigilante talent which you have already selected.

Legendary Classes: Cloak & Dagger, © 2025, Legendary Games; Authors: Andrew J Gibson, Cerise Herndon, Connor Bates, Jason Nelson, Jeff Lee, Kieran “Kazu” Easter, Margherita Tramontano, Matt Goodall, Mia Yoshida, N. Jolly, Nate Wright, Norman Mitchell, Tara Collins.
